input: Pitch a feature article to a travel magazine

gold.taskTitle: Pitch a Feature Article to a Travel Magazine
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to pitch a feature article idea to a travel magazine, with the goal of getting it accepted for publication.

questions.title: What destination or travel topic is your article about?
questions.description: Understanding the specific subject matter of the article idea the user wants to pitch.

questions.title: Which specific travel magazine are you targeting?
questions.description: Identifying the exact publication the user intends to pitch to, such as Conde Nast Traveler, National Geographic Traveler, Afar, etc.

questions.title: Have you been published before, or is this your first pitch?
questions.description: Determining the user's writing and pitching experience level to tailor the plan appropriately.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline or target date to send the pitch?
questions.description: Establishing any time constraints that will shape how the task plan is structured.

questions.title: Have you already visited the destination or done the research?
questions.description: Clarifying whether the article is based on personal experience or will require additional research or a press trip.

questions.title: Do you have a specific editor contact at the magazine?
questions.description: Finding out whether the user already has an editorial contact or needs to identify the right person to pitch to.

questions.title: Do you have a draft of the pitch letter already written?
questions.description: Determining how far along the user is in the process, so the plan starts at the right step.
